candidates.title: Anthropic Institute 'Economic Scenarios for Transformative AI': extreme scenario puts knowledge-worker unemployment near 18% by 2030
candidates.claimed_occupations: Knowledge or cognitive workers (unemployment and wages); labor share overall.
candidates.claimed_summary: Anthropic Institute Working Paper 2026-02 (Korinek, Jones, Sacher, Cotter, McCrory) models three US scenarios for 2026-2030, published with an interactive explorer. In the modest scenario (internet-like) AI adds little to growth and about 0.1 pt to unemployment. In the substantial scenario AI does about half of knowledge work, with knowledge-worker wages flat. In the extreme scenario growth reaches about 15% a year, the labor share falls from about 60% to 45%, and unemployment reaches roughly 11.9% overall and about 17.9% for knowledge workers. Anthropic stresses these are scenarios, not forecasts. Headlines such as Yahoo Finance's 'push knowledge-worker unemployment to 18%' emphasized the destruction tail. DATE CAVEAT: outlets give September 9 or 10, and 2026-09-10 is Fortune's date. Figures differ across secondary sources; verify against the PDF.

I kept 2026-09-10, which comes from the Fortune URL path; I saw that path but could not open the article. The month falls inside the 2026-06-10..2026-10-10 window. 2) Title and label: Anthropic's page is titled "Scenarios for our Economic Future" (anthropic.com/institute/econ-scenarios, written by Santi Ruiz).
